hotels.title: Iconic InterContinental Hayman Island Resort with One of Australia's Largest Swimming Pools
hotels.description: Located on the shores of the sunkissed Whitsundays, InterContinental Hayman Island Resort is a jewel surrounded by breathtaking natural beauty. An icon of island luxury with direct access to the shimmering waters of the Great Barrier Reef, this magnificent resort invites you to take a dip in one of Australia's largest swimming pools or recline in a private pool cabana overlooking shimmering ocean waters. Unwind in the tranquil embrace of the onsite spa, savour gourmet delights at four distinct dining venues and be captivated by the mesmerising sunsets that paint the sky each evening.Whether you’re looking for out-of-this world diving, a romantic escape or a dreamy setting for a family trip, this world-class resort is where travel memories are made.
